## Technical Structure & Archive Sections

### 1. Android Tools (`/archive/android-tools/`)
Utilities for Android firmware, root, and recovery scenarios:
- FRP Bypass Helper: Web-based intent launcher for Android settings, lock screen setup, and browser activities directly via Chrome intents on Android devices.
- Hardware Sysfs Controls: Scripts for direct `/sys/class/led/` interaction (e.g. Ares Backlight Changer).
- WearOS Utilities: Activity inspection and shortcut pinning on watch hardware.

### 2. Documentation & Research (`/docs/`)
Technical notes covering chipset behaviors (MediaTek MTK protocols, DA/brom interfaces), Android super.img LP partition header structures, and bootloader reverse-engineering observations.

### 3. Web Tools (`/archive/web-tools/`)
Lightweight browser-based client-side tools:
- gh-boards: Open-source SVG generator for GitHub profile statistics, download counters, and star badges.
- Text Formatter: In-browser text cleaning and whitespace manipulation.
- FPS Tester: Display refresh rate and frame delivery tester.

### 4. LLM Automation (`llm-adb`)
Specialized token-efficient wrapper around Android Debug Bridge (ADB) optimized for autonomous AI agent inspection and UI manipulation without wasting token budget on verbose XML hierarchies.
